description: Spark & Wire Electrical is a family-owned electrical business serving Geelong and the Surf Coast for over 15 years. We specialise in residential rewiring, switchboard upgrades, solar panel installations, and EV charger setups. What sets us apart is our same-day emergency service and upfront fixed pricing — no hidden call-out fees.
